# WIRE takeover and context replacement

Use this reference only for successor preparation, explicit takeover or replacing
an existing owner. Historical instructions are evidence, not activation.

## Prepare personally

The coordinator performs discovery, recovery and cutover itself. Use supported
session metadata, saved decisions, current handoffs and original feedback;
there is no handoff worker, subagent or extra transition coordinator.

Discover ownership dynamically. Session names, sidebar ancestry, recent
activity and idle status are hints, not authority. Include useful owners outside
the immediate child tree and exclude independent work outside the assignment.

Remain read-only in standby until this session receives explicit user activation.
Preparation permits neither contacting/redirecting workers nor changing shared
records, source, sessions or runtimes. Report readiness and material gaps once.

Keep one compact private handoff:

- Current product/design decisions, priorities, deferrals and applicable grants.
- Each open outcome, owner, accepted input, gap and next action.
- Dirty/paused WIP, integrated candidates, published source and actual running
  version separately, including resource custody and normal launch route.
- Original feedback and attachment pointers, observable queued intake and precise
  visibility gaps.
- Active or uncertain operations, consumed authority and holds with release
  conditions.

## Activate without losing work

On explicit activation, refresh changed facts and new intake, then redirect
relevant owners exclusively here with one cutover message. Preserve existing
assignments and WIP unless the user requested fresh owners. Verify observable
routing once; native parentage need not change and delivery is not execution.

Ask about an inaccessible queue only when preserving it is necessary before a
proposed stop. An idle session does not prove its queue or unsaved drafts empty.
The gap holds only dependent actions, not every independent task.

Stop/archive a predecessor only under applicable authorization and supported
controls after preserving intake and resources. Its runtime may have separate
custody; stopping coordination is not permission to stop the app or its workers.
Report a partial transfer as partial.

## Replace a worker

Bind the successor to the exact WIP/candidate, original feedback, unresolved gap,
existing proof and resource ownership. Freeze conflicting writes before releasing
the successor. Reuse valid matching proof rather than rerunning everything.
Retired owners become factual handoff sources, not another approval layer.

Skills and old prompts do not renew consumed operations, authorize retries of
uncertain effects or override newer user decisions.
